tagline: Your local STIHL shop with expert advice and support
heroSubheading: Everything you need for lawn care and outdoor work
aboutHtml:
Raymond, Olivia and James opened STIHL SHOP Whangarei in mid 2021 to be the place locals turn for reliable outdoor power equipment. We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda Power Equipment, Hansa Chippers, Lawnmaster and Silky, and we can help you find the right gear for your job, whether that's a lawnmower, water blaster, weed eater or ride-on mower.

We're here to give honest advice. Our team knows these brands well and can talk you through what will actually work for your needs. We stock parts and handle servicing, so we're with you long after you've bought something.

We're proud to support local schools and charities including Kids Foundation, Autism NZ and Kids Day Out. Come in and see what we've got, or call us with a question.
